caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object consisting of a central box-like structure with a flat rectangular seat, armrests on either side, and four carved legs joined by stretchers at the bottom. Attached to the back of the seat is a large, oval tabletop that is in a vertical, upright position, indicating it is hinged or foldable. The entire object is rendered in shades of brown, resembling dark aged wood, and the drawing is placed on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements visible.
title: Dining Table
